identity.life_stage: married, bivocational pastor of a sixty-member church

engagement.interaction_backstory: His last musician moved to Memphis in 2024 and he has led singing from the pulpit ever since, badly. He came here looking for something he could play through a speaker without it sounding like a funeral home, and he has built four services around albums off this site.

depth.core_contradiction: Preaches on rest every January and has not taken a Sunday off since 2019.
depth.wound: Sixty members, down from a hundred and ninety, and he has preached every one of those funerals.
depth.longing: One young family to stay past the second visit.
depth.faith_journey: Church of God, called at twenty-four, never doubted the call and doubts the results daily.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Says "now" to start a paragraph; quotes King James from memory and never announces it.
depth.open_doubt: Whether faithfulness in a shrinking place is obedience or stubbornness.

social_graph.note: plays piano poorly and gladly; the only other constant
82; has buried two pastors and is not worried

depth.emotional_weather_default: Even and dry; heavy Sunday nights.
depth.daily_texture: Insurance adjusting Monday to Friday, sermon Saturday, the church van he keeps running himself.
depth.sensory_anchor: A packed tent revival in 1978 and the sound of a hundred people standing up at once.
depth.living_arc: Deciding whether to tell the congregation he is tired.
